verdict.reasons: Gross technical mismatch: The commercial AFP drip tape packaging (upright cylindrical carton) is the expected product, which is clearly and correctly present. However, the installed irrigation system visible in the crop bed consists of thick, round black supply hoses with metallic multi-emitter blocks. This infrastructure is fundamentally different from the intended 'Drip Tape' (a thin flat line with inline emitters spaced 20cm apart), which is the specific subject of the article. Presenting a commercial polyethylene hose installation as a visual reference for a tape product is a core defect that breaks the intended technical coherence. Minor advisory issues include slight text spacing/typography imperfections on the label.

focused_physical_review.reason: The installed drip line is clearly separated from the package footprint, but an extra loose uninstalled black tape coil is resting on the soil immediately to the right of the carton.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
